verdict.rationale: Mesh can be driven entirely without its web UI. The docs describe machine API credentials with configurable permissions and expiry, synchronous, asynchronous and batch screening APIs, and webhook-driven results such as WORKFLOW_COMPLETED. Case review and remediation, exports and transaction processing are also available via API, and a published OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema and Postman collection support scripted integration. Missing for 10: no official CLI or CI-specific guidance or examples, and no independent or hands-on evidence of an authenticated automated run.
